basis: The official Midlothian county archive was retrieved anonymously and audited in native EPSG:27700. All 3148 bounding-box candidates were valid; 2222 full polygons intersect the 1 km WUP-centered circle. The exact locator has no covering polygon; the nearest same-ID source feature is about 2.96 m away. The local index contains 1709 positive-area overlap pairs, including 1259 of at least 1 m² and a maximum 14313.205 m². RoS explicitly permits overlapping and stacked polygons in this index model. The source is valid in that model, but is incompatible with exclusive 2D ground-parcel rendering until those source semantics are represented. No geometry repair, removal or substitution was used.
